# Chunks<AvailableFrom v="4.0.540" />

## JavaScript API

The frame range that each Lambda function renders, as a list of `[startFrame, endFrame]` pairs. Use it instead of setting the number of frames per Lambda or the concurrency when the cost of rendering is uneven, so that expensive parts of a video get split into shorter chunks than cheap parts.

## Command line

The frame range that each Lambda function renders, as a list of `[startFrame, endFrame]` pairs. Use it instead of setting the number of frames per Lambda or the concurrency when the cost of rendering is uneven, so that expensive parts of a video get split into shorter chunks than cheap parts. Pass a JSON array, or a file path pointing to a JSON file.

## CLI flag

```text
--chunks <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#chunks)
